customProps.description: Master the fundamentals of robot control - from kinematics and dynamics to PID controllers and simulation environments
learningObjectives: Apply forward and inverse kinematics to humanoid robot arms and legs
Understand robot dynamics and how physical laws constrain motion
Design and implement PID and model predictive controllers
Simulate humanoid robots in Gazebo and NVIDIA Isaac Sim
Analyze and debug control systems using ROS 2 tools
